title: Q-RECUR-39caaf9374: pr-stuck recurred 10x: ol-pr land or supersede pull request needs
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** the failure miner files it after every merge and daily
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation failmine --probe 39caaf9374
**Status:** closed

Recurring failure, class `pr-stuck`, seen 10 times (open 2, last 2026-11-21T08:19:47+00:00).
Signature: ol-pr land or supersede pull request needs
Events: OL-PR-694, OL-PR-709, OL-PR-710, OL-PR-737, OL-PR-812, OL-PR-841
Root cause (5 whys): nothing server-side owns the PR after the session that opened it ends
Owning mechanism: seed/worker/src/sweeper.js lane
Seen three or more times: incident. Redesign the owning mechanism so this class cannot recur; a fourth attempt of the same fix is not allowed.

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation failmine --probe 39caaf9374

**Disposition:** shelved (executor-failed, 2026-11-21T20:21:19Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** the executor failed 3 consecutive runs on this item; last reason: RuntimeError: checks failed after 2 attempts: the reply was not valid JSON with a files list: ValueError: seed/worker/src/sweeper.js: the FIND text is not in the file (or matches more than one place); copy the lines exactly as the file show. Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
